have.def: The set of reasons and their arrangement used to support a claim.

have.def: A judgement reached by reasoning from premises.
ex_de: Die Schlussfolgerung ist kühn, aber logisch zwingend.

have.def: To present and explain something clearly and in full.

have.def: To consider a question carefully from various sides.

have.def: Tightly reasoned and consistent throughout.
ex_de: Die Studie ist methodisch stringent aufgebaut.

have.def: A proof or record that supports a claim.

have.def: The scholarly assessment of how reliable a source is.

have.def: A figure of speech that describes one thing as if it were another.

have.def: The expression of meaning through language that signifies the opposite.

have.def: A statement that makes something seem greater than it is.

have.def: The sharp, telling point of a joke or remark.

have.def: The compelling, insistent quality that makes something strike home.

have.def: A formal spoken presentation to an audience.

have.def: The smooth, uninterrupted flow of spoken language.

have.def: What is true and matches the facts.

have.def: A feeling of not being sure about something.

have.def: The power of the mind to think logically and judge soundly.

have.def: Awareness of oneself and the world; also the state of being awake.

have.def: The fact or manner of existing.

have.def: The way something is noticed or understood through the senses.

en: to fathom, get to the bottom of

have.def: To explore something deeply until it is understood.
ex_de: Die Psychoanalyse will die Motive hinter dem Handeln ergründen.

have.def: A trait of good moral character.

have.def: The idea that people can choose their actions freely.

have.def: Based on ideas rather than physical things; not directly representing reality.

have.def: The voice that tells a story.

have.def: A particular point of view; also the sense of depth in a picture.

have.def: A look back at earlier events; in a story, a scene from the past.

have.def: A recurring theme in a work; also a reason for acting.

have.def: Something that stands for or represents something else.

have.def: To explain the meaning of something; also to point.

have.def: Figurative language that creates vivid pictures in the mind.

have.def: Open to several meanings.

have.def: The facts that make up an offence in law; the essential facts.

have.def: The body of decisions made by courts; the administration of justice.

have.def: To punish an offence officially.

have.def: Able to be defended as reasonable or acceptable.

have.def: Legal responsibility for damage or debt.

have.def: The mental capacity to be held responsible for one's acts.

have.def: To take responsibility and be accountable for something.

have.def: Bezeichnung für Regierende, Personen mit Leitungsfunktion
ex_de: Die Herrschaft versammelte sich im Palast.

have.def: Eigenschaft, anerkennungswürdig (legitim) zu sein, weil gewisse moralische, aber auch gesetzliche Normen und Wertvorstellungen eingehalten sind

have.def: The power or right to give orders; also an expert.

have.def: über Einfluss verfügend

have.def: A mild word used in place of a harsher or blunter one.

have.def: Kennwort, Codewort (meist bei militärischen, polizeilichen, verbrecherischen oder anderweitig zu tarnenden, geheimzuhaltenden Handlungen)
ex_de: „Halt! Parole?“ „Nullacht“ „Fünfzehn! Passieren!“

have.def: weithin bekannte, griffige Formulierung einer Idee oder Vorstellung, die vor allem in der gesellschaftlichen oder politischen Auseinandersetzung oder auch in der Werbung als programmatisch oder vorbildlich hingestellt werden soll
ex_de: Die Schlagworte der Französischen Revolution waren „Freiheit, Gleichheit, Brüderlichkeit“.

have.def: Information spread to promote a cause and shape opinion, often one-sidedly.

have.def: etwas, das jemandem suggeriert wird

have.def: etwas als besser, schöner darstellen, als es in Wirklichkeit ist

have.def: Art und Weise, wie man etwas tut, um ein Ziel zu erreichen; Vorgehen
ex_de: Eine Methode für einen effizienten Softwareentwurf heißt „Extreme Programming“.

have.def: pragmatisch (auf relevante Eigenschaften) verkürzte (verkleinerte) Abbildung

have.def: A model or framework of thought accepted in a field.

have.def: Glaube an einen (noch) nicht erwiesenen oder nicht beweisbaren Sachverhalt, eine Hypothese oder Axiom

have.def: A claim put forward to oppose another.

have.def: The proving of a theory to be false through testing.

have.def: To check and confirm that something is true.

have.def: The state of not knowing what will happen.

have.def: For the time being; not yet final.

have.def: A fixed expression whose meaning is not literal.

have.def: A short, well-known saying that states a general truth.

have.def: A worn-out phrase used with little real meaning.

have.def: The style of language suited to a particular situation.

have.def: A secondary meaning or feeling that a word carries.

have.def: The informal language of everyday speech.

have.def: A fine shade of meaning, feeling, or tone.

have.def: A quality of feeling beneath what is openly said.

have.def: To adjust a colour or a meaning by a subtle degree.

have.def: Exactly right and well chosen.

have.def: The study of beauty and taste in art.

have.def: A quality of awe-inspiring grandeur beyond ordinary beauty.

have.def: A pleasing arrangement of parts; agreement and balance.

have.def: Art or objects seen as cheap, sentimental, and in poor taste.

have.def: The ideas or tastes shared by most ordinary people.

have.def: Artists whose work is experimental and ahead of its time.
ex_de: Die Avantgarde der Zwanziger brach radikal mit der Tradition.

have.def: The flavour of food; also a person's sense of style.

have.def: A judgement based on personal values rather than fact.

have.def: To recognise and honour the worth of something.

have.def: Showing good judgement of what is beautiful or fitting.

have.def: A demanding task that tests one's abilities.

have.def: A profound and far-reaching change.

have.def: Able to remain workable and sustainable in the years ahead.

have.def: Something handed down by a predecessor; also property left in a will.

have.def: To predict something; also to choose not to do something.

have.def: To wish someone good luck.
